BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the B1-1 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 52-B in the area bounded by:

West Irving Park Road; a line 279.88 feet east of and parallel to
North Central Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to
West Irving Park Road and extended West where no alley exists;
and North Central Avenue

to those of a C2-1 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 5555 West Irving Park Road
